questions.question: Paul wrote that Christ died and returned to life for what reason?

answers.text: To be Lord of both the dead and the living
To settle every dispute over food
To make one day holier than the rest

questions.question: Paul asked why believers should judge or belittle a fellow believer. What reason did he give to stop?

answers.text: We will all stand before God's judgment seat
The apostles will sort it all out
Others will only judge us back

questions.question: Paul said the kingdom of God is a matter of eating and drinking. True or false?
When believers disagreed over food and special days, what did Paul tell them to pursue?

answers.text: What leads to peace and builds each other up
Whatever proves which side is right
Strict rules for every meal they share
